business_summary: Tianjin Development Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, supplies water, heat, thermal power, and electricity in China and Hong Kong. It operates through six segments: Utilities, Pharmaceutical, Hotel, Electrical and Mechanical, Port Services, and Elevators and Escalators. The company engages in the supply of tap water, installation and maintenance of water pipes, technical consultancy, and retail and wholesale of water pipes and related parts, as well as water testing services; distribution of steam and heat for industrial, commercial, and residential customers; and supply of electricity, construction of electricity supply network, application of technology related to new energy and renewable energy, and electricity construction and related technical services, as well as energy storage technology services. It also manufactures and sells chemical drugs, Chinese medicines, and other healthcare products; researches and develops medicine technology and products; designs, manufactures, and prints pharmaceutical packaging; and sells other paper-based packaging materials. In addition, the company operates the Courtyard Hotel by Marriott Hong Kong; manufactures and sells hydroelectric equipment and large-scale pump units; provides port services; and manufactures and sells elevators and escalators. Further, it is involved in the finance lease business. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Central, Hong Kong. Tianjin Development Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Tsinlien Group Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: Tianjin Development Holdings Limited는 자회사를 통해 중국과 홍콩에 물, 열, 화력, 전기를 공급합니다. 유틸리티, 제약, 호텔, 전기 및 기계, 항만 서비스, 엘리베이터 및 에스컬레이터 등 6개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 수돗물 공급, 수도관 설치 및 유지 관리, 기술 컨설팅, 수도관 및 관련 부품의 도소매, 수질 테스트 서비스를 제공합니다. 산업, 상업, 주거용 고객을 위한 증기 및 열 분배; 전력공급, 전력공급망 구축, 신에너지 및 재생에너지 관련 기술의 응용, 전력건설 및 관련 기술서비스, 에너지저장기술 서비스 등을 포함합니다. 또한 화학약품, 한약, 기타 건강관리 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 의학 기술과 제품을 연구하고 개발합니다. 의약품 포장을 디자인, 제조 및 인쇄합니다. 기타 종이 기반 포장재를 판매합니다. 또한 회사는 Courtyard Hotel by Marriott Hong Kong을 운영하고 있습니다. 하이드로일렉트를 제조, 판매하고 있습니다.
